name: hankha-print-bridge
description: Local helper that prints POS receipts and labels on a venue's own hardware — over the network (ESC/POS-over-TCP), a USB print queue, or a serial/Bluetooth port. Runs on a venue PC, NOT inside the POS terminal's PWA: a browser cannot open any of those. It also dials out to the cloud API, so a phone can print through it without reaching the LAN.
